title: 26 By Biosemi
description: EEG dataset recorded with a Biosemi system from participants receiving laser stimulation to elicit pain. After the laser intensity was calibrated to an average rating of about 7 on a 0-10 scale, each participant received 16 fixed-intensity laser stimuli roughly 20 seconds apart and rated the pain intensity after each one. The dataset supports research on pain perception and laser-evoked brain responses.
methods_description: Laser stimulus intensity was first calibrated so that the average pain rating was about 7 out of 10. Each participant then received 16 fixed-intensity laser stimuli approximately every 20 seconds while fixating on a cross with eyes open. After each stimulus, participants rated pain from 0 (no sensation) to 10 (intolerable), 3-5 seconds after stimulation. EEG was recorded with a Biosemi system.
